title: The crypto privacy rule Trump’s Treasury proposed, and Trump’s Treasury buried
summary: On Dec. 18, 2020, with Christmas a week away and Donald Trump preparing to leave the White House, Steven Mnuchin's Treasury Department announced a plan that would require crypto exchanges and other financial institutions to collect more information about transactions involving wallets people controlled themselves.
